requirement_summary.heading: Section 1: File Structure
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
Section 1: File Structure
A DIF file MUST begin with the TABLE keyword.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 1: File Structure
requirement_summary.text_fragment: The TABLE record MUST be on the first line.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 1: File Structure
requirement_summary.text_fragment: Files MUST use structured records with a keyword per line.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 2: Records
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
Section 2: Records
The VECTORS record MUST appear after TABLE.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 2: Records
requirement_summary.text_fragment: The TUPLES field MUST equal the number of data rows.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 2: Records
requirement_summary.text_fragment: The DATA record MUST follow VECTORS.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 3: Data Block
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
Section 3: Data Block
The DATA block MUST be terminated by an EOD record.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 3: Data Block
requirement_summary.text_fragment: Each tuple MUST start with a BOT record.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 3: Data Block
requirement_summary.text_fragment: String values SHOULD be enclosed in double quotes.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 4: Encoding
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
Section 4: Encoding
Files SHOULD use ASCII encoding.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 4: Encoding
requirement_summary.text_fragment: Integer values SHOULD NOT have decimal points when integral.

requirement_summary.heading: Section 5: Termination
requirement_summary.text_fragment:
Section 5: Termination
The EOD record MUST be the last record.
